Tidy Impulse-Response Function

Source: R/irf.R
tv_irf.Rd

Tidier for the varest, vec2var and svarest class.

Usage

tv_irf(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
tv_irf(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'varest'
tv_irf(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'vec2var'
tv_irf(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'svarest'
tv_irf(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of the varest, vec2var and svarest class.

...

Additional objects to be pass through.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

model <- vars::VAR(EuStockMarkets)

tv_irf(model)
